1	/-

     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSheafification
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Comparing raw Pic0 Sigma with its big-etale sheafification
    11	
    12	The raw Pic0 Sigma functor is already a sheaf for the big-etale topology. After the
    13	universe lift required by the Scheme site, the sheafification unit is therefore an
    14	isomorphism. This file bundles that sheaf and records the canonical comparison used by
    15	the quotient-Yoneda step.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory Opposite
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    29	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    30	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    31	
    32	/-- The universe-raised raw Pic0 Sigma presheaf satisfies the big-etale sheaf
    33	condition in its sieve form. -/
    34	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_ulift_isSheaf_etale :
    35	    Presieve.IsSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology
    36	      (pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1}) :=
    37	  Presieve.isSheaf_comp_uliftFunctor Scheme.etaleTopology
    38	    (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf_etale C)
    39	
    40	/-- The universe-raised raw Pic0 Sigma presheaf is a big-etale sheaf. -/
    41	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_ulift_presheafIsSheaf_etale :
    42	    Presheaf.IsSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology
    43	      (pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1}) :=
    44	  (isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ _).mpr
    45	    (pic0SigmaFunctor_ulift_isSheaf_etale C)
    46	
    47	/-- The universe-raised raw Pic0 Sigma functor bundled as a big-etale sheaf. -/
    48	noncomputable def pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf :
    49	    Sheaf Scheme.etaleTopology.{u} (Type (u + 1)) :=
    50	  ⟨pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1},
    51	    pic0SigmaFunctor_ulift_presheafIsSheaf_etale C⟩
    52	
    53	/-- The natural isomorphism from universe-raised raw Pic0 Sigma to the underlying
    54	presheaf of the sheafification used as the admissible Abel target. -/
    55	noncomputable def pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso :
    56	    (pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1}) ≅
    57	      (pic0SigmaEtaleSheafification C).obj :=
    58	  isoSheafify Scheme.etaleTopology
    59	    (pic0SigmaFunctor_ulift_presheafIsSheaf_etale C)
    60	
    61	/-- The same canonical comparison bundled in the category of big-etale sheaves. -/
    62	noncomputable def pic0SigmaEtaleSheafIso :
    63	    pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf C ≅ pic0SigmaEtaleSheafification C :=
    64	  sheafificationIso (pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf C)
    65	
    66	/-- The underlying hom of the comparison is exactly the sheafification unit. -/
    67	@[simp]
    68	theorem pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso_hom :
    69	    (pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso C).hom =
    70	      toSheafify Scheme.etaleTopology
    71	        (pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1}) :=
    72	  rfl
    73	
    74	/-- The bundled and unbundled comparisons have the same underlying natural map. -/
    75	@[simp]
    76	theorem pic0SigmaEtaleSheafIso_hom :
    77	    (pic0SigmaEtaleSheafIso C).hom.hom =
    78	      (pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso C).hom :=
    79	  rfl
    80	
    81	/-- Component form of the canonical-map identification. -/
    82	@[simp]
    83	theorem pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso_hom_app (T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ) :
    84	    (pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso C).hom.app T =
    85	      (toSheafify Scheme.etaleTopology
    86	        (pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1})).app T := by
    87	  rw [pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso_hom]
    88	
    89	end
    90	
    91	end AlgebraicGeometry

id: AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.datum-tail.abel-quotient

summary: 'Prove the single endpoint `noncomputable def pic0AdmissibleAbelQuotientRepresenter
  {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
  [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] : Sigma fun Q : Over (Spec (.of
  k)) => (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy Q`. Accepted only when the body directly
  consumes `divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy`, chooses the admissible Abel
  datum internally, and constructs in Scheme over Spec k an effective quotient of
  `divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C` by the kernel relation of the concrete admissible
  `chartValueAffTrans` or its `abelSigmaChartAff` form. Identify that kernel with
  the relative and etale-local linear-equivalence relation seen by `relPic` and `picEt`,
  including the `picFromBase` quotient; prove the admissible Abel transformation is
  locally surjective as an etale-sheaf map; and identify the quotient Yoneda functor
  with `pic0TypeFunctor C`. Establish the required quasi-projectivity or concrete
  project-local embedding. No equivalent Prop, class, structure, Nonempty, or existential
  reformulation; no projection wrapper; and no binder for RepresentableBy, IsRepresentable,
  HasSmoothProperQuotient, open-atlas coverage, rational points, local surjectivity,
  a kernel-pair representer, or quotient data counts as progress. The raw admissible
  Abel map only feeds this quotient: positive-dimensional linear-system fibres prevent
  it from being an open Pic0 atlas.'
